title: Canzoneri 2013 amputation/prosthesis PPS
citation: Canzoneri, E., Marzolla, M., Amoresano, A., Verni, G., & Serino, A. (2013). Amputation and prosthesis implantation shape body and peripersonal space representations. Scientific Reports, 3, 2844.
notes: Upper-limb amputation/prosthesis PPS profile. The profile captures the reported dynamic IN/OUT pink-noise task, T1-T5 tactile timing, upper-arm electrical tactile target, auditory-only catch rows, and two-block runner contract. Clinical group, prosthesis-worn state, and tested limb/body-part assignment are retained as analysis/context metadata rather than separate audio-tactile task mechanics.

reference_parameters.prosthesis_factor: healthy limb, amputated limb without prosthesis, and amputated limb with prosthesis are paper-level condition/context factors
reference_parameters.trial_family_scaffold: Canzoneri-style dynamic IN/OUT pink-noise task without tactile-only T0/T6 baselines
reference_parameters.reported_trial_count_caveat: The PDF Methods sentence reports 8 target stimuli for each T1-T5 temporal delay for IN and OUT sounds, which implies 80 target rows, but the same sentence says this resulted in 76 tactile-target trials. The runnable profile preserves the factorial T1-T5 x IN/OUT x 8 structure and the reported 76 auditory-only catches; the literal 76-target wording remains a source inconsistency caveat.
reference_parameters.baseline_subtype: none reported for Experiment 2/3 audio-tactile task
reference_parameters.response_rule: speeded response to tactile target, ignore sound
remaining_caveats: internal paper count inconsistency: 8 x 5 x 2 implies 80 tactile-target rows, while the PDF says 76 tactile-target trials
exact original pink-noise seed/asset and SoundForge-style gain envelope are not available
electrical current/electrode calibration was reported as above threshold but not as a participant-level current table
voice-key hardware threshold and latency correction are approximated by the mouse-click response proxy

metadata.source_asset_equivalence: procedural pink-noise proxy for unshared original sound file
metadata.renderer_equivalence_boundary: binaural virtual trajectory proxy for physical near/far speakers

provenance.source: Scientific Reports article reports PPS testing in upper-limb amputees with healthy limb, amputated limb without prosthesis, and amputated limb with prosthesis conditions.

Scientific Reports Methods report 3000 ms pink-noise IN/OUT sounds, 1000 ms pre/post silence, T1-T5 at 300, 800, 1500, 2200, and 2700 ms from sound onset, 76 auditory-only catch trials, and two blocks.

The Methods sentence simultaneously reports 8 target stimuli per T1-T5 x IN/OUT cell and a 76-trial tactile-target total; the profile preserves the coherent factorial target structure and records the literal total as a caveat.
